title: Olugendo lw'Omwoyo Ogukuziddwa
intro: Mu kiseera ng’emisingi gy’abantu gifuga, omuntu ow’enjawulo yafuna enkyukakyuka ey’amaanyi mu maka agalina omukisa. Emboozi yaabwe, eraga omuguwa gw’omukwano n’ekiragiro kya Katonda, eraga okumenya ennono enkadde n’okuteekebwawo kw’emisingi emipya, emituukirivu. Ennyonnyola eno eraga obukulu bw’amazima okusinga enkuŋŋaana n’amagezi agali emabega w’ebiragiro bya Allah.
clues: Lumu nnali musibe, naye okuyitira mu nteekateeka ya Katonda, nnafuna amaka amapya n’amaka amapya.
Nnali mwagalwa nnyo ne kiba nti bwe nnaweebwa okulonda wakati w’ab’omu maka gange ag’obuzaale n’omukuumi gwe nnazaala, nnasalawo okusigala n’abo abasembayo.
Lumu erinnya lyange lyali likwataganyizibwa n’omukuumi gwe nnakuza, omuze ogwali gutera okubeera mu bantu bange.
Nze omubeezi yekka wa Nabbi asembayo erinnya lye Allah lye yayogerako mu bulambulukufu mu Quran.
Nawasa omukazi ow’ekitiibwa eyali mujja wa Nabbi, naye obufumbo bwaffe tebwawangaala.
Oluvannyuma lw’okwawukana kwange, Allah yennyini yalagira eyali mukyala wange okuwasa Nabbi, bw’atyo n’aggyawo obulombolombo obw’edda obukwata ku kuzaala.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
